notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). The skill designs a three-tier multi-AZ VPC and builds it with AWS CLI commands (VPC, subnets, IGW, NAT gateways, route tables, security groups, VPC endpoints, flow logs, peering) and an equivalent Terraform module, plus a troubleshooting table.

Medium: following it has the agent create billable AWS networking resources (Elastic IPs, NAT gateways, interface endpoints), open ALB security groups to 0.0.0.0/0 on 80/443, and create/accept VPC peering using the user's configured AWS credentials. Acceptable because it builds new infrastructure the user asked for, contains no delete/destroy commands or disabled security controls, and tiers security groups so app and database only accept traffic from the tier above.

Account IDs, ARNs and VPC/route-table IDs (123456789012, 987654321098, vpc-requester, rtb-accepter) are placeholders.
